Container.Name: pulse
Container.Overview: Lightweight self-hosted monitoring and alerting dashboard for Unraid, Docker, Proxmox, Kubernetes, TrueNAS, and Linux/Windows/macOS hosts. Tracks host health, disk SMART vitals, Unraid array status, container stacks, backups, availability checks, and built-in metric history from one container. Open http://[IP]:7655 within 10 minutes of first boot to create your admin account, or run /app/pulse bootstrap-token in the container console if the window expires.
Container.Description: Lightweight self-hosted monitoring and alerting for Docker, Unraid, Proxmox, Kubernetes, TrueNAS, and standalone hosts.

Config.Description: Persistent configuration, credentials, alerts, and metric history. Must stay on persistent storage so container updates do not reset Pulse.
